topic: Database connection errors and data cleaning
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on persistent database connectivity issues observed in the AllUnite environment. [p1] reported repeated connection reset errors from Superset logs, suggesting a potential system check or job issue rather than user error. [me] addressed an unrelated data dictionary issue that was fixed by rolling back changes.

Regarding Superset, [me] cleared unnecessary datasets to mitigate the spamming/error rate. A suggestion was made to improve caching performance by implementing Redis instead of relying on the current cache mechanism.
decisions: Unnecessary datasets were cleared from Superset.
action_items: Investigate persistent connection reset errors in Superset logs (assigned to someone/Tole).
